# Gidi

> Gidi is a free web app and an open model that read short, informal Vietnamese personal-finance notes such as "ăn phở 45k" or "cho Nam mượn 2 củ" and return the transaction type (one of 8), the counterparty and the amount in VND. Everything runs in the user's browser: no note text, name or amount is sent anywhere.

Gidi (from "GiaoDịch", Vietnamese for "transaction") is Vietnamese-first. The model is `gidi-finance-v3` (release 3.0.0): one INT8 encoder for type and target plus a rule-based value parser, 29.3 MB as INT8 ONNX, about 1.4 ms p50 per note on one CPU thread, licensed Apache-2.0. On the 190-note test set `human-value-02`: type 92.1%, target 85.3%, value 100%, end-to-end exact 78.9%. It is an experimental project, not financial advice, and not a bank or accounting product.

## App

- [Gidi app](https://gidi.8bu.dev/): the free notes app, Vietnamese interface, runs in the browser, no account

## About pages

- [Giới thiệu Gidi (Vietnamese)](https://gidi.8bu.dev/gioi-thieu): what Gidi is, the 8 types, slang amounts, privacy, accuracy and FAQ
- [About Gidi (English)](https://gidi.8bu.dev/about): the same content in English
- [Full English facts](https://gidi.8bu.dev/llms-full.txt): all facts in one plain-markdown file, suitable for citation

## Code and model

- [GitHub: 8bu/gidi](https://github.com/8bu/gidi): source code for the app, training and evaluation
- [Hugging Face: x8bu/gidi-finance](https://huggingface.co/x8bu/gidi-finance): the gidi-finance-v3 model (INT8 ONNX, Apache-2.0)
